name: Origami Card
description: A small folded square of paper that opens hinge by hinge into a flat card, keeping its creases.

props.name: children
props.description: What is written inside the sheet. It fills the square once it is open.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled state. Opening unfolds the last fold first; closing folds them back in the order they were made.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the packet is opened or folded up.

props.name: folds
props.description: How many times the sheet is halved, alternating across and down. Four folds make a packet a quarter of the width.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the open sheet in pixels. It shrinks to fit a narrower container.

props.name: label
props.description: Written on the outside of the packet, and the name of the button that opens it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Text of the small button that appears in the corner of the open card on hover or focus.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the printed outside of the paper. The inside is plain.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a square group; give it an aria-label.
